attchmntText: Ems Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication on Standalone and consolidated Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Lerthai Finance Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting a net profit of 6.49 lakhs and earnings per share of 0.93. GCM Securities Limited reported a net loss of 80.58 lakhs for the same period, with earnings per share of negative 0.04. Powai Lake Residential Private Limited received environmental clearance from the State Environment Impact Assessment Authority, Maharashtra, on November 5, 2026, for a proposed building in Mumbai. Arpanna Motors Private Limited and Arpanna Developments Private Limited have been directed by the National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench, to hold meetings of secured and unsecured creditors on December 14, 2026, to consider a scheme of arrangement. The meetings are scheduled for 11:00 a.m. and 12:00 noon. The scheme is subject to creditor approval and subsequent tribunal sanction. Rahul Anand Drolia is the chairperson and Harsh Ruparelia is the scrutinizer for these meetings.

attchmntText: Ems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: EMS Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 12th, 2026. The Board considered and approved the Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Audit Committee reviewed these results on the same date. Statutory Auditors M/s Ajay K. Kapoor & Company submitted a Limited Review Report. The report states that nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements in the financial statements prepared under Indian Accounting Standard 34. The standalone revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs 16089.43 Lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs 2292.58 Lakhs. For the half year, revenue was Rs 28641.85 Lakhs and profit after tax was Rs 3195.22 Lakhs. The consolidated results include subsidiaries such as SKUEM Water Projects Private Limited and EMS Green Energy Private Limited. The meeting commenced at 03:30 P.M. and concluded at 03:45 P.M.

attchmntText: Ems Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: EMS Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call for Friday, November 13th, 2026, at 12:00 P.M. to discuss financial performance for the second quarter and half year ended September 30th, 2026. The company is filing this intimation pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during the meet. The disclosure will be hosted on the company website at www.ems.co.in. The notice is signed by Ashish Tomar, Managing Director and CFO, with DIN 03170943.
